def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    spot_rate = 2.0979
    domestic_interest_rate = 0.032875  # NZD
    foreign_interest_rate = 0.016025   # GBP
    period_days = 180
    basis_points_multiplier = 10000

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    domestic_factor = 1 + domestic_interest_rate * period_days / 360
    foreign_factor = 1 + foreign_interest_rate * period_days / 360

    forward_rate = spot_rate * (domestic_factor / foreign_factor)
    forward_points = (forward_rate - spot_rate) * basis_points_multiplier

    # return answer
    return round(forward_points, 3)
